newsitem.title: JAPAN: IHI says strengthens tie-up with Photon Dynamics.
newsitem.headline: IHI says strengthens tie-up with Photon Dynamics.

text.p: Japan's Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries Co Ltd (IHI) said on Tuesday that it had strengthened a tie-up with Photon Dynamics Inc, a leading U.S. maker of inspection equipment and testers for liquid crystal displays (LCDs).

The heavy machinery maker said in a statement that it will start selling such Photon Dynamic products as final inspection systems, active matrix liquid crystal display in-process functional testers and integrated laser welders.
IHI will sell the Photon Dynamics' products in Japan, while a Japanese unit of Photon Dynamics will provide back up sales support.
The two firms agreed to strengthen the tie-up due to expectations that LCD production will soar in Japan, IHI said.
